prompts.title: Casual Nighttime Study Session Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a woman sitting indoors in a cozy, dimly lit room at night. Use the uploaded reference image for exact facial identity and natural facial proportions, preserving the same face shape, skin texture, and distinctive features without altering her identity.
She has neatly styled hair falling naturally around her face and shoulders. She wears an oversized black sweatshirt with soft textured fabric. She sits at a wooden study table with her elbow and forearm resting naturally on the tabletop, while her hand gently supports the side of her cheek/jaw. Her other arm rests comfortably in front of her, creating a relaxed, slightly introspective pose. Her body is angled subtly toward the camera while her face looks directly into the lens. Her expression is calm, soft, and slightly happy.
Composition: close-up to medium portrait, eye-level camera angle, subject centered, face as the primary focal point, natural framing with her upper body and surrounding room visible. Foreground contains a few stacked books on a wooden study table, softly blurred to create depth.
Environment: cozy bedroom/study interior with a deep blue wall, several small framed photographs/polaroid-style pictures arranged casually on the wall, a dark shelf with books and objects in the background. A small table lamp is visible on the left side, producing a soft blue glow. Include subtle lifestyle details such as a dark takeaway cup on the table.
Lighting: dramatic blue cinematic night lighting, with cool blue ambient illumination throughout the room and a stronger blue light coming from the left/front side. Add a subtle blue rim light around the woman's hair and shoulders, gentle highlights on her face, and soft shadows across the darker side of her clothing. Maintain realistic skin tones despite the predominantly blue environment. Low-key lighting, atmospheric shadows, soft falloff, subtle glow, and cinematic contrast.
Camera & quality: shot on an 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, realistic optical bokeh, sharp focus on the eyes and face, softly blurred foreground and background, natural perspective, ultra-detailed skin texture and fine hair strands, detailed fabric texture, cinematic color grading, deep blacks, rich blue tones.
Style: photorealistic, ultra-detailed, cinematic editorial photography, moody midnight aesthetic, natural skin texture, realistic anatomy, authentic indoor atmosphere, premium photography, 8K detail, aspect ratio 4:5 composition.

prompts.title: Warm Indoor Portrait of a Writer
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded reference image strictly for accurate face/identity matching. Preserve the exact facial identity, facial structure of the reference person.
Create an ultra-realistic cinematic portrait of a man studying at a wooden desk in a warm, moody room. He is seated naturally behind an open notebook/book, holding a black pen in one hand as if taking notes.
Subject & Appearance:
Man with neatly styled hair, slightly messy, clear natural skin texture, and realistic facial proportions. He wears a simple black crew-neck knit sweater with subtle fabric texture. Maintain a natural, youthful appearance.
Pose & Expression:
Seated at the desk, upper body leaning slightly forward. One hand holds a black pen above the open notebook while the other arm rests naturally on the desk. His head is turned slightly toward the right side of the frame, looking off-camera with a calm, thoughtful, introspective expression. Natural relaxed posture and realistic hand anatomy.
Environment:
A cozy, dimly lit study/bedroom interior. Dark wooden desk in the foreground with an open notebook or textbook, several slightly blurred books, and subtle everyday study objects. In the background, a warm neutral-colored wall with a few minimalist framed posters/art prints. Keep the background softly out of focus so the subject remains the main focus.
Lighting:
Strong warm golden-hour sunlight entering from a window on the right side, creating dramatic rectangular window-light patterns and soft shadows across the wall and subject. Warm highlights on his face and hair, with the opposite side falling into deep cinematic shadow. Natural volumetric light, subtle dust particles, rich contrast, soft falloff, and an intimate evening-study atmosphere.
Composition:
Vertical 4:5 portrait composition, medium shot from approximately waist/chest level, subject centered. Include the wooden desk and open notebook in the foreground. Keep the face as the visual focal point. Background elements should remain recognizable but heavily softened by shallow depth of field.
Camera & Quality:
Photorealistic photography, cinematic editorial aesthetic, 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, realistic perspective, soft natural bokeh, high dynamic range, detailed skin pores, individual hair strands, realistic fabric texture, natural shadows, subtle film grain, warm cinematic color grading, 8K ultra-detailed quality.
